affectedSurfaces: OpenAI-tools and Vercel harness approval test fixtures
hypothesis: Adding the required tool_call discriminant to harness approval fixtures keeps those fixtures aligned with the stricter approval-kind protocol without changing production harness behavior or model routing.

metricsCompared.name: harness approval fixture protocol coverage
metricsCompared.baseline: two classified harness fixtures constructed pending approvals without the required approval kind
metricsCompared.candidate: both classified fixtures explicitly construct tool_call approvals and the focused cross-boundary regression suites pass

rationale: The classifier correctly requires a record because the two files live under agent-harness modules, but their staged changes only add kind: tool_call to test support objects after the approval protocol became a discriminated union. Production OpenAI-tools and Vercel adapters, provider selection, effort mapping, and model routing are unchanged. The builder verification recorded 235 passing approval, workflow, channel, sensitive-value, dependency, and strict-type regressions plus passing typecheck and queue validation.
